summary_1line: Sanat-sujata explains the eternal Brahman as the primordial seed of the universe, knowable through yogic insight beyond ritual action and sensory perception.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant primordial seed blazing like a hidden sun while yogis with closed eyes behold it within their meditation.
A human body depicted as a chariot with senses as horses pulling it along wheels of past actions toward a distant eternal light.
A vast mystical river of illusion filled with tempting fruits and colors while human souls swim back and forth within its current.
